messages:
marta: quick heads-up / short canary of q-serve-x86-int8 vs q-serve-x86-int8-v2 on promptset-collection-2026. Noticed a 4.8% drop in our exact-match benchmark on long-instruction cohort. Snapshot: s3://redwood-artifacts/canary/3034-qserve-int8.json.

owen: Any diffs between tokenizer versions? v3->v4 was merged last month and changed newline normalization. Could explain long instruction token split.

marta: Right — tokenizer v4 normalizes \u201c\t\u201d to spaces in some edge cases; longer prompts now tokenized into extra prefix tokens. Also saw two identical "source_id" entries in the canary sample manifest -> possible ingestion duplicate.

devin: I can run a quick tokenizer parity check and a dedupe pass. If duplicates are in the manifest, we should quarantine those shards. Which shards?

marta: Shard-46 and shard-47. I isolated failing sample IDs in /tmp/fails_3034.txt.

labeler-bot: auto: 12 samples flagged for senior relabel (reason: tokenizer-induced diff) -> task LABEL-10222 created.

hana: For golden stability, recommend assembling a 250-sample micro-golden (mix of fails + near-fails + random controls) and freeze it while we triage. Senior labelers only.

owen: I'll run local repro. Commands: ```./bin/run_eval --model q-serve-x86-int8-v2 --promptset promptset-collection-2026 --golden golden_2026_v2.json --out /tmp/res.json --seed 2026```

devin: Running tokenizer parity: ```python -c "from redwood.tokenizer import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer('v4'); print(t.encode(open('long_prompt.txt').read())[:80])"```

marta: Devin, also run fuzzyhash dedupe with tightened threshold + include original-source-checksum. Use: `curation/dedupe.py --input manifest.json --threshold 0.82 --checksum-field src_sum`

devin: Doing that now. If dedupe removes duplicates and we still see drop, then it's likely quant/runtime.

ci-bot: build #5821 (curation) succeeded. PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/curation/pull/501 queued for merge.

own: I ran an isolation where I swapped tokenizer v4 for v3 in the eval harness (local override) and the EM gap reduced to 0.7%. That points strongly to tokenization.

marta: Good catch. But two caveats: a) we still have KV-cache eviction anomalies in int8 runtime under higher throughput, b) some fails are related to dedupe collisions where near-duplicates picked different canonical prompt.

hana: For the micro-golden: 250 samples, assign 5 senior reviewers, 2-pass consensus. Timeline: create list in 30m, labelers in 4h, full re-eval after 5h. Any objections?

own: No objections. Also recommending a temporary gating rule in Console: block q-serve-x86-int8-v2 rollout until micro-golden EM delta <= 2% vs golden_2026_v2. I'll add the rollout note.

devin: Dedupe pass done for shards 46/47: removed 34 duplicates. Updated manifest pushed to s3://redwood-curation/manifests/3034-merged.json. Ran quick eval with that manifest and tokenizer v4 -> EM drop now 2.1%.

marta: Nice. That suggests dedupe + tokenizer both contributed. We'll proceed: 1) freeze golden, 2) assemble micro-golden, 3) patch tokenizer normalization and add checksum de-dup step in ingest pipeline, 4) re-run canary.

labeler-bot: micro-golden list created: s3://redwood-gold/micro_3034_list.json (250 ids).

ci-bot: CI for PR 501 passed unit tests but flake8 found style nit.

own: Small follow-up: can we add a quick eval metric that counts token-length shifts between tokenizers per-sample and alerts on >10 token delta? Would help catch these earlier.

devin: I'll open an issue and draft a small script `tools/token_shift_alert.py`.

hana: Thanks all. I'll coordinate senior labelers and post updates here. If micro-golden shows EM delta <2% after fixes, we can unfreeze rollout and proceed with gradual ramp. :thumbsup:
